notes.title: Update: New Shops, Achievements, Sounds, Tweaks, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Howdy, hope everyone is having an absolute [i][b]decent[/b][/i] Friday ːlunar2019piginablanketː

I got some solid updates for you today—new stuff to explore, new achievements, some new epic sounds, tweaks, and some bug fixes. A lot [i]in store[/i]. Here's what it is:

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/e50f617ff4c67845c8ac09fd9824e4e3e64e1305.gif[/img] Shop Update[/h2]
Twelve brand new frog shops are waiting for you, as well as the new and improved shop tile, which is impervious to explosives. I added some challenges to some of the shops so you can risk it all for the biscuit, if you so choose. Here's one of em:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/74f959b297d07f0be29613c3be74bae893158a65.png[/img]

[h2]7 New Achievements[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/b941f6031c7478a6c83fe526cc7c3ec7055408d7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/ac6ee5de61065daf210388ef767518b37e1857b5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/8fdf91951061d01ef87965b197b256154ab5750c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/5cee2b22c09a2ca894adb1ffa44eb8a0eca26b93.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/de4de8f4ac94cf52a41b4273ff4257b207492d5e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/472352953a230af9e8915120247fa20edfdf7240.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/22118bf24dc45531972cbd636240cf9e201b7965.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/220e940a965ef64b5aee09e83f9f0b8d272cb63d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/f961deb8fb2a8394e38be72d5c12f2e564f9da2f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/76a181ec476c7229900a31d7191e24b20ed604f6.png[/img][/url]
New achievements for the following:
[list]
[*] Finishing the tutorial (Reaching the Buried Treetops)
[*] Reaching the Toxic Burrow
[*] Reaching the Sacrificial Sanctum
[*] Reaching the Ancient Ruins
[*] Defeating the Gargantuan Worm
[*] Acquiring a special weapon upgrade
[*] Making a [b]bold[/b] purchase
[/list]

[h2]New Delicious Sounds[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wooden doors now make unique sounds when they open and close.
[*] Torches have ambient "torchy" sound and an extinguishing noise when they go out.
[*] Toxic shrooms now hiss with poison gas when they explode.
[/list]

[h2]New Mechanics And Other Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Torches can be extinguished via explosions.
[*] Wooden Doors Open Automatically: Gone are the days of slapping and smashing doors. They now open as you walk through, and they make some nice sounds too.
[*] Toxic Shrooms Make You Slip: Stepping on a toxic shroom will now make you slip and fall—unless you’re crouching. If you crouch, you’ll avoid slipping.
[*] Added some new Worm Boss rooms.
[/list]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210017/0a73dfb5af46de454b8bad8ca283c32e633a7064.png[/img] Bugs SLAPPED And Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chamber 6 no longer leads to the wrong transition level.
[*] The Worm boss now plays the right death sound.
[*] Mosquitos finally chase the center of the player, instead of his toes.
[*] Maggot hitbox monitoring state now resets properly after recovery.
[*] Frog Merchant can no longer be exploded (for now.)
[*] Reduced drop rate of emeralds from slimes.
[*] Value of emeralds dropped by slimes has been fixed.
[*] Cannibal meat now heals you, as it should.
[*] You can now shove items into walls if you do it properly
[*] Fixed shop labels appearing behind Frog Merchant dialogue
[*] More bug fixes that we won't speak of...
[/list]

That’s all for today folks. Thanks for reading.

- Jon

notes.title: Hotfix Notes For Sep 25, 2024
notes.notes:
Just a small patch to fix a bug brought to my attention on the Discord server!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where exiting a dungeon on the first chamber would heal the player
[*] Increased the drop rate of rat meat, worm meat, cannibal meat
[*] Cannibals have a higher chance of dropping gems
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This update is in preparation for the new prologue and boss I'm adding to the demo. Stay tuned ;)

[list]
[h1][b]Updates:[/b][/h1]
Fixed boulder z-sorting issue with player
Player now correctly goes into the heavy item state when picking up heavy items while crouched
Adjusted and optimized platform dropping
Fixed bug related to music in the main menu
Fixed collision boxes for mushroom trees
New UI arrangement
Updated tutorial beginning
Some colors have been reworked (player, cannibal, etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
SLIME!

[list]
[h1][b]New:[/b][/h1]
[*] New coin animations
[*] New juicy and delicious gems
[*] New chest graphics
[*] New title screen song
[*] New logo
[*] New Item: Magnetite - The player will attract coins and break coin piles automatically from a distance
[*] New temple entrance chunks in the Jungle
[*] Slime chunks have been added into the jungle
[*] New slime blocks
[*] New chain hit VFX
[*] 150% more variety in the level generation
[*] New enemies: Classic slimes (with intellect)

[h1][b]Tweaks:[/b][/h1]
[*] Small chests have a higher chance of containing gems
[*] Enemies will no longer bounce around on walls when hostile and falling
[*] Enemies who are hostile will idle if stuck
[*] Enemies now only inflict damage when attacking or hostile instead of on-touch
[*] Rats and Worms have decreased health
[*] Worms no longer leave behind a corpse
[*] Fixed starting position in one jungle level (player was falling on start)
[*] Fixed boulder trap graphics resetting to the untriggered state after reentering a level from a sub-level
[*] Fixed bugged boulder sound
[*] Bonfire size reduced by 25%
[*] Tutorial has been updated once again
[*] Fixed z sorting issue for some heavy objects
[*] Added particle for ladder placement
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

[*] Closed off some unused areas in the lobby
[*] Set fullscreen mode as default
[*] Refined beginning jungle rooms
[*] Added 10 new mud temple rooms

[*] Settings and language selection menu QoL updates
